notes: Run of 2026-11-21. Twelve Registry stories queued; seven name San Francisco buildings. One earns an entry: the closed $7.5MM sale of 960 Howard to Community HousingWorks. Declined: two pending deals, a withdrawn listing (and its roundup), a suite lease, a sale whose headline names a family trust, and a second account of Alo Yoga at 170 Post. The other five are market and policy reports whose address hits are sidebar links.

findings.description: Closed sale: Community HousingWorks, a nonprofit affordable-housing developer, bought 960 Howard Street from the developer oWOW for $7.5 million; oWOW had spent five years trying to add housing above the converted warehouse. Both parties are firms. Dated to publication; the story gives no closing date.

citation.label: The Registry, “Community HousingWorks Buys oWOW’s 12,000 SQFT 960 Howard in San Francisco’s SoMa for $7.5MM,” 19 November 2026

publish.note: Entry on /san-francisco/south-of-market/howard-street/954/ as the-registry-2026-11-19; homepage card added. No building fields: a sale, and the housing addition is unbuilt.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 960 HOWARD ST → parcel 3725019; sf-parcels has blklot 3725019 active, 954–960 HOWARD; the 2025 roll records it as industrial. EAS puts 954, 960 HOWARD ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 954.
